tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your friend Jasmine are planning to host a fundraising event for your university's tennis team. You have thought about some activities for the event, but you need Jasmine's input to finalize the plans. You also want to discuss the best time to meet and work out the details. Write an email to Jasmine.
bullets: Describe the activities you propose for the fundraising event.
Explain why you think these activities will be successful.
Suggest a meeting to discuss the plans in more detail.
tasks.subject: Fundraising event planning
